mapper.sql:
FROM PRODUCT p JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id LEFT JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.base_category_id = c.category_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND p.status != 'DELETED'
AND ( LOWER(p.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(pr.biz_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner_query.*, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS name, p.producer_id AS producerId, pr.biz_name AS producerName, p.base_category_id AS baseCategoryId, c.category_name AS baseCategoryName, p.main_image AS mainImage, p.status AS status, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id AND o.order_date >= SYSDATE - 30 ) AS recentSalesQty, TO_CHAR(p.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS createdDate
ORDER BY p.created_date DESC ) inner_query WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE rnum > #{offset}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS name, p.producer_id AS producerId, pr.biz_name AS producerName, NVL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS salesQty, NVL(SUM(oi.line_total_amount), 0) AS salesAmount FROM PRODUCT p JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS_ITEM oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= SYSDATE - #{period} AND p.status != 'DELETED' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.producer_id, pr.biz_name
ORDER BY salesAmount DESC
ORDER BY salesQty DESC
) WHERE ROWNUM <= 50
